analysis: OFF-2 selection-based improvements (Oracle / SC-best-of-5 / CAAP-selection) across twelve baseline models
baseline_definition: Each model's highest quality-only (D5=0, D1-D4 renormalized) single-strategy total.

caap_selection.note: NOT directly comparable: offline is pure strategy selection over the four existing baselines (no augmentation); existing -caap adds L2/L3/L4 prompt augmentation on a zero-shot base with fresh generation. Offline is a lower bound.

oracle.note: existing -oracle is a per-level cherry-pick re-evaluated end-to-end; the offline per-level oracle should closely match; per-instruction is a strictly stronger upper bound.

sc_best_of_5.note: existing -sc uses a zero-shot base re-evaluated across all dimensions; the offline uplift touches only the D4/satisfaction term, so some divergence is expected.

method_notes.caap_selection: NO-AUGMENTATION lower bound: caap.select_strategy picks a strategy; that strategy's existing per-instruction score is used. Real CAAP additionally injects L2 checklist / L3 formulas / L4 domain priors requiring new generation (excluded).
method_notes.oracle_per_instruction: Exact: per-instruction max quality-only level_score across available strategies.
method_notes.sc_best_of_5: Best-strategy jsonl; per-sample satisfaction_rate (== runners._score_sample); uplift = max-of-5 minus mean-of-5, folded through renormalized D4 weight and added to the faithful stored baseline total. Absolute satisfaction != stored D4 (per-level MAE ~0.08-0.19), so only the internally-consistent delta is used.
